hints.browser_navigate: It does not return the page: call browser_snapshot next to read it.
hints.browser_snapshot: Returns the page as text, each element with a ref: use the ref with browser_click or browser_type.

hints.generate_photo: Automatically parks ShadowZero GPUs, saves an HD PNG, and reloads ShadowZero; mention the returned /v1/media/ file and saved path in your answer.
hints.generate_video: Automatically parks ShadowZero GPUs, saves an HD H.264 MP4 (or animates image_path), and reloads ShadowZero; mention the returned /v1/media/ file and saved path in your answer.
hints.upscale_media: Upscales an existing photo or video to 4K (3840x2160 by default) using Real-ESRGAN AI super-resolution and NVENC/H.264, automatically parking/reloading ShadowZero GPUs.
